+import pytest
+
+from jinja2 import DictLoader
+from jinja2 import Environment
+from jinja2 import Template
+from jinja2 import TemplateNotFound
+from jinja2 import TemplatesNotFound
+from jinja2 import UndefinedError
+
+
+class RecordingLoader(DictLoader):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__({"scope/good": "{{ token }}"})
+        self.lookups = []
+
+    def get_source(self, environment, template):
+        self.lookups.append(template)
+        if template == "scope/undefined":
+            raise UndefinedError("loader cannot resolve this candidate")
+        return super().get_source(environment, template)
+
+
+class RelativeEnvironment(Environment):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__(loader=RecordingLoader(), cache_size=0)
+        self.joins = []
+        self.errors = {
+            "rejected": TemplateNotFound("internal/rejected"),
+            "rejected2": TemplateNotFound("internal/rejected2"),
+        }
+
+    def join_path(self, template, parent):
+        self.joins.append((template, parent))
+        if template in self.errors:
+            raise self.errors[template]
+        return f"{parent}/{template}"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["select_template", "get_or_select_template"])
+def selection_api(request):
+    return request.param
+
+
+def test_rejection_falls_back_and_success_stops(selection_api):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    names = ["rejected", "missing", "good", "unused"]
+    result = getattr(env, selection_api)(names, "scope", {"token": "selected"})
+    assert result.name == "scope/good"
+    assert result.render() == "selected"
+    assert names == ["rejected", "missing", "good", "unused"]
+    assert env.joins == [(n, "scope") for n in names[:3]]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == ["scope/missing", "scope/good"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("names", "lookups"),
+    [
+        (["rejected", "rejected2"], []),
+        (["rejected", "missing", "rejected2"], ["scope/missing"]),
+        (["missing", "rejected"], ["scope/missing"]),
+        (["missing", "missing2"], ["scope/missing", "scope/missing2"]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_exhausted_lists_report_original_candidates(selection_api, names, lookups):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    originals = list(names)
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        getattr(env, selection_api)(names, "scope")
+    assert caught.value.templates == originals
+    assert caught.value.name == originals[-1]
+    assert str(caught.value) == str(TemplatesNotFound(originals))
+    assert names == originals
+    assert env.joins == [(n, "scope") for n in originals]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == lookups
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("error_type", [UndefinedError, ValueError, TypeError])
+def test_non_missing_join_errors_abort(selection_api, error_type):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    error = error_type("joining failed")
+    env.errors["bad"] = error
+    with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught:
+        getattr(env, selection_api)(["rejected", "bad", "good"], "scope")
+    assert caught.value is error
+    assert env.joins == [("rejected", "scope"), ("bad", "scope")]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prefix", [[], ["rejected"]])
+def test_template_passthrough_never_joins(selection_api, prefix):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    template = Template("passthrough")
+    result = getattr(env, selection_api)(prefix + [template, "good"], "scope")
+    assert result is template
+    assert env.joins == [(n, "scope") for n in prefix]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("error_type", [TemplateNotFound, UndefinedError, ValueError])
+def test_get_template_propagates_join_failure(error_type):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    error = error_type("single lookup rejected")
+    env.errors["bad"] = error
+    with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught:
+        env.get_template("bad", "scope")
+    assert caught.value is error
+    assert env.joins == [("bad", "scope")]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == []
+
+
+def test_loader_undefined_remains_a_candidate_miss(selection_api):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    names = ["rejected", "undefined", "missing", "good"]
+    result = getattr(env, selection_api)(names, "scope")
+    assert result.name == "scope/good"
+    assert env.joins == [(n, "scope") for n in names]
+    assert env.loader.lookups == ["scope/undefined", "scope/missing", "scope/good"]
+
+
+def test_loader_undefined_exhaustion_uses_original_names(selection_api):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    names = ["rejected", "undefined", "missing"]
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        getattr(env, selection_api)(names, "scope")
+    assert caught.value.templates == names
+    assert caught.value.name == "missing"
+    assert str(caught.value) == str(TemplatesNotFound(names))
+    assert env.loader.lookups == ["scope/undefined", "scope/missing"]
+
+
+def test_empty_list_diagnostic_is_unchanged(selection_api):
+    env = RelativeEnvironment()
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        getattr(env, selection_api)([], "scope")
+    assert str(caught.value) == "Tried to select from an empty list of templates."
+    assert env.joins == []
+    assert env.loader.lookups == []

spec.question:
Support candidate rejection by parent-relative path resolution. When a subclass's join_path raises TemplateNotFound while Environment.select_template is processing a concrete candidate list with a parent, selection should skip that candidate without consulting the loader and try the next one. Any other exception from join_path, including UndefinedError, must escape immediately without trying later candidates. If all candidates are rejected or absent, raise TemplatesNotFound with the original candidate list in order, the last original candidate as name, and the same message as TemplatesNotFound constructed from that list; joined names and rejection messages must not replace those diagnostics.

Apply this contract to concrete lists passed through get_or_select_template as well. Return a Template object encountered in the list unchanged, without joining or loading it, and stop at the first successful candidate. Keep get_template's existing behavior of propagating a joining failure. TemplateNotFound and UndefinedError raised during loader lookup must remain candidate misses; the attached pytest output also shows a regression in that existing Undefined behavior. Iterable-exhaustion diagnostics are outside this change. Deliver a unified diff against production files only, leaving tests unchanged.
